name: Hospital patient-safety ratings by state and county: PSI 90 and healthcare-associated infections (CMS Care Compare)
description: How Medicare's Care Compare rates hospitals on patient safety, for each state, DC and territory and for each county with at least three hospitals: how many hospitals are rated worse, the same or better than the national benchmark on the PSI 90 patient-safety and adverse-events composite (claims July 2022 to June 2024), and on the six healthcare-associated infection ratios (October 2024 to September 2025), with each state's own infection ratios and confidence limits as CMS prints them. Counties with fewer than three hospitals are combined. Hospital names are not kept. Every figure is as CMS prints it.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Hospital patient-safety ratings by state and county: PSI 90 and healthcare-associated infections (CMS Care Compare) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963670
keywords: hospital patient safety ratings by state
hospital infection ratios SIR by state

distribution.name: hospital-safety.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: hospital-safety.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: hospital-safety-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in hospital-safety-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to hospital-safety.csv on id.

recordSet.name: hospital-safety
recordSet.description: The records of Hospital patient-safety ratings by state and county: PSI 90 and healthcare-associated infections (CMS Care Compare), one per CSV row.

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: value
field.description: Hospitals in Care Compare (the same as hospitals)

field.name: hospitals
field.description: Hospitals in the CMS Care Compare hospital file

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
